apiKey_help: Free from Meteonomiqs (button next to it). Stored encrypted.
enableAstro_help: Sunrise, sunset, twilight, day length, moonrise, moon phase.
enableCurrent_help: The values of the current hour, updated every hour. Needs hourly values.
enableExtended_help: Useful for comparing against a local weather station and for ventilation logic.
enableHourly_help: One value per hour. Creates many data points.
enableJson_help: All days in one data point, e.g. for VIS, Jarvis or Material widgets.
enableSnow_help: Snow line and fresh snow. Mainly relevant at altitude or in winter.
enableSpaces_help: Morning, afternoon, evening and night per day.
enableWarnings_help: Official weather warnings with text and level 0–4.
forecastDays_help: 1 to 14. More days mean more data points, but no extra API calls.
hourlyDays_help: Each day adds about 620 data points.
httpTimeout_help: How long to wait for the answer. Do not go below 20 on a slow Raspberry Pi.
info_budget: The free plan allows 100 calls per month. The adapter spreads them over the month by itself. Only change this if you have a different plan.
info_data: Choose which values are created. This costs no extra calls, only more data points. On a Raspberry Pi, hourly values for one day are enough.
info_schedule: Here you set when the adapter fetches the forecast. Each row is one fetch per day. The default (three times a day) fits the free plan.
info_start: 1. Get a free API key from Meteonomiqs (button below) and paste it into the field. 2. Save. That's it: the weather data appears in the objects under meteonomiqs.0. You can leave all other settings as they are.
info_tier: Priority: 1 is the most important fetch. If the calls of the month run short, the row with the highest number stops first. In a normal month this does not happen.
language_help: Language of texts such as "partly cloudy". Unsupported languages fall back to German.
maxRetries_help: How often to try again after a network or server error. Each try costs one call.
minHoursBetweenUpdates_help: Two automatic fetches are never closer together than this. Protects the monthly limit when ioBroker restarts often.
monthlyLimit_help: Free plan: 100. 0 = no limit (only for paid plans without a limit).
reserveCalls_help: Retries after an error stop when only this many calls are left.
support_text: The adapter is free. If it is useful to you, you can support its development voluntarily.
useSystemLocation_help: Uses the location from Settings → System → Location. Switch off to enter the coordinates yourself.
